title: QinetiQ Target Systems Canada deep-dossier refresh

selectedGap.reason: The published record has one umbrella capability and lacks its principal aerial and naval product families, current field activity, Canadian operating context and active naval-target program.

guardrailNotes: The candidate preserves the published organization and existing umbrella capability; proposed changes are additive except for an evidence-backed profile_data refresh that retains all prior review metadata.
The exact current Ontario legal entity remains unresolved, so legalName is not changed. No canonical record changes before explicit human publication.

candidates.reviewerRationale: QinetiQ Target Systems Canada is already published, but the record materially understates the Medicine Hat operation by collapsing its portfolio into one generic capability. Official product pages and CanadaBuys evidence support distinct Banshee aerial targets, Hammerhead and Barracuda naval targets, deployable control and field services, and a current C$47.97 million Canadian naval-target standing offer. A March 2026 exercise account confirms current Canadian team activity. The refresh preserves existing IDs and prior metadata; the reviewer should verify the present Ontario legal entity before adding a legal name.
reviewWarnings: The former federal QinetiQ Target Systems Canada Inc. corporation was discontinued to Ontario in 2017, while current CanadaBuys history uses QinetiQ Group Canada Inc.; legalName remains unchanged pending current Ontario-registry confirmation.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: QinetiQ states that it manufactures target systems in Alberta and offers aerial, rotary-wing, land and naval targets, special-mission vehicles, command and control, scoring, launchers and turnkey field services.
QinetiQ's March 2026 report identifies the Canadian Target Systems team and documents deployment and remote control of ten Hammerhead targets in three multinational exercise scenarios.
CanadaBuys lists QinetiQ Target Systems Canada at Unit 3, 1735 Brier Park Road NW in Medicine Hat and records 95 employees on the amended naval-target standing offer.

The Banshee Jet 80 official page documents twin turbine propulsion, land and sea launch, use with surface-to-air and air-to-air weapon systems, modular target enhancement and realistic infrared signatures.
CanadaBuys identifies QTS as a Canadian aerial-target equipment and services provider and documents Banshee use across a broad set of ground-based and naval air-defence systems.

QinetiQ's official surface-target portfolio describes Hammerhead, Barracuda, Sprite II and tow targets for naval live-fire readiness, fast-attack-craft and piracy scenarios, including simultaneous control of up to 40 targets.
The Hammerhead MkII product page supports line-of-sight and over-the-horizon control, 35-knot operation in Sea State 3, payload customization and swarm threat representation.
CanadaBuys records a C$47,967,583 naval air-and-sea target standing offer for QinetiQ Target Systems Canada, awarded in May 2022, amended in January 2026 and expiring in March 2027.

after.canadianFootprint: Target-system manufacturing and field-service operations at Unit 3, 1735 Brier Park Road NW, Medicine Hat, Alberta. CanadaBuys listed 95 employees on the current naval-target standing offer.
after.portfolioScope: Threat-representative aerial, rotary-wing, land and naval targets; special-mission uncrewed vehicles; command and control; radar, acoustic and visual scoring; launchers; payloads; and deployable field services for live-fire training and weapon-system test and evaluation.
after.currentActivity: QinetiQ Target Systems Canada deployed and remotely controlled ten Hammerhead USV targets during Exercise Cobra Gold in March 2026. Its Canadian naval air-and-sea target standing offer was amended in January 2026 and runs through March 2027.
after.publicContact: CanadaBuys publishes a Canadian customer-account contact at (587) 554-6932 and ryan.peterson@qinetiq.ca; the canonical QinetiQ site also provides a corporate contact form.
after.evidencePosture: Official QinetiQ product and newsroom pages establish the technology portfolio and current field activity. CanadaBuys establishes current Canadian procurement, location and operating-name evidence. The exact current Ontario legal entity name should be confirmed before populating legalName.
